shellCommands.command: pwd && rg --files -g '!node_modules' | head -80 && printf '\n--- status ---\n' && git status --short

find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | head -120; printf '
--- AGENTS ---
'; sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; printf '
--- package ---
'; sed -n '1,220p' package.json
find src test -type f | sort; printf '\n--- thumbnail references ---\n'; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=node_modules -E 'finite|preload|thumbnail|Thumbnail' src test | head -240

sed -n '1,260p' src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx; printf '
--- tests ---
'; sed -n '1,320p' test/unit/plugins/Thumbnails.spec.ts; printf '
--- carousel ---
'; sed -n '1,230p' src/modules/Carousel.tsx; printf '
--- test helpers ---
'; sed -n '1,220p' test/unit/utils.tsx

git log --oneline --all -- src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx | head -30; printf '
--- relevant history ---
'; git blame -L 80,125 src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx; printf '
--- configs and state ---
'; sed -n '1,220p' src/contexts/LightboxState.tsx; sed -n '1,180p' src/utils.ts
git show --stat --oneline bafdda0 && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff bafdda0 -- src/modules/Carousel.tsx src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx test/unit

git branch -a; printf '
--- recent commits ---
'; git log --oneline --decorate -25; printf '
--- all thumbnail commits after current ---
'; git log --all --oneline -- src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx | head -60; printf '
--- package vitest config ---
'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*vitest*' -o -name 'vite.config.*' \) -print -exec sed -n '1,180p' {} \;
git remote -v && sed -n '1,180p' src/plugins/thumbnails/thumbnails.scss && sed -n '1,140p' src/plugins/thumbnails/Thumbnail.tsx
git show 9a60b54^:src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx | sed -n '80,145p'; git show 9a60b54:src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx | sed -n '80,145p'
git ls-remote https://github.com/igordanchenko/yet-another-react-lightbox.git HEAD refs/heads/main 2>/dev/null | head

git fetch --quiet https://github.com/igordanchenko/yet-another-react-lightbox.git main && git log --oneline HEAD..FETCH_HEAD -- src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx | head -20 && git diff HEAD..FETCH_HEAD -- src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx | head -240

git show f63f6af --stat --oneline; git show f63f6af -- src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx src/modules/Carousel.tsx test/unit/plugins/Thumbnails.spec.ts src/utils.ts src/props.ts | sed -n '1,300p'; git show f63f6af^:src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx 2>/dev/null | grep -n -A45 -B10 'preload' | head -100
grep -RIn 'export.*utils\|from "./utils' src/index.ts src/*.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/index.ts; sed -n '1,80p' src/types.ts; sed -n '1,140p' src/props.ts
tail -35 src/utils.ts; sed -n '1,25p' src/utils.ts
npx vitest run test/unit/plugins/Thumbnails.spec.ts
git diff --check && git diff -- src/utils.ts src/modules/Carousel.tsx src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx test/unit/plugins/Thumbnails.spec.ts
npm run build
npx vitest run
git status --short; git diff --check
git diff --stat; git diff --numstat
tail -3 src/modules/Carousel.tsx; tail -3 src/plugins/thumbnails/ThumbnailsTrack.tsx; tail -3 test/unit/plugins/Thumbnails.spec.ts
